units.source_text: “越轨的事我做不来，还是天生做不来啊。

en.t: I just cannot do anything improper; I suppose I was born unable to.

units.source_text: 我是很爱惜自己的身子的。

en.t: I take very good care of my own body.

units.source_text: 要是我愿意，可以把四年期限缩成两年，可我不想勉强去做，还是身子要紧。

en.t: If I wanted to, I could shorten the four-year term to two years, but I do not want to force myself; my health matters most.

units.source_text: 勉强做了，也许会赚到许多钱。

en.t: If I pushed myself, I might earn a great deal of money.

units.source_text: 期限嘛，不让主家吃亏就行。

en.t: As for the term, it is enough as long as I do not make the house lose money.

units.source_text: 每月本钱多少，利息多少，税金多少，加上伙食费，一算就明白了。

en.t: Once you calculate the monthly principal, the interest, the taxes, and add food expenses, it becomes clear.
It is enough if I earn what I need; I will not force myself.

units.source_text: 碰上麻烦的宴会，厌烦死了，我就赶紧回来。

en.t: If I run into a troublesome banquet and get thoroughly fed up, I come straight back.

units.source_text: 要不是熟客点名叫，太晚了，客栈也不给我来电话。

en.t: Unless a regular customer asks for me by name, the inn will not phone for me too late at night.

units.source_text: 自己要是大手大脚，就成无底洞了。

en.t: If I were extravagant myself, it would become a bottomless pit.

units.source_text: 赚到够开销，那就可以了。

en.t: As long as I earn enough to cover my expenses, that is fine.

units.source_text: 本钱我已经还了一半以上。

en.t: I have already paid back more than half of the principal.
It has not even been a year yet.

units.source_text: 不过，零用钱什么的，每月也要花三十元。”

en.t: Still, spending money and things like that cost me thirty yen a month.
